title: 花旗杨霭蔚：阿里云增速上调，美团预期过高需谨慎
speaker: Alicia Yap

segments.en: Okay, Tencent is just the beginning of this whole China Tech earnings season. Let's talk about the others. What are you watching out for the most for the rest of it? What do you think investors need to look out for the most this time?
segments.zh: 腾讯只是中国科技财报季的开始。其他公司方面，您最关注什么？这次投资者最需要留意什么？

segments.en: Next week, obviously, we have Baba, and then we have Baidu. Both of them will also show, you know, the compute powers, like in terms of their cloud revenue growth.
segments.zh: 下周有阿里和百度，两家都会展示云收入增长方面的算力。

segments.en: Baba, in our preview, we raise our cloud revenue estimate to 45%, so they are accelerating from 38% last quarter.
segments.zh: 阿里方面，我们预览中将云收入预期上调至45%，较上季的38%加速。

segments.en: So hopefully, they're going to achieve that. And then for Baidu, last quarter, they already achieved like 80%, like 79%, on the AI cloud info revenue.
segments.zh: 希望他们能实现。百度上季AI云收入已增长79%，本季我们预计62%，略有放缓，部分因上季基数高。

segments.en: So this quarter, we model 62, is slightly salary, partly because, you know, last quarter is so high. And then after that, then we have, Maituan hasn't announced the reporting date, but Maituan is also another name that a lot of clients actually paying attention to these days. Why?
segments.zh: 本季我们预计62%，略有放缓，部分因上季基数高。之后是美团，虽未公布日期，但许多客户近期关注。为什么？

segments.en: Well, partly because I think, you know, their bounce back really, you know, well, on to the from the load in end of June, partly because of the earnings revisions is very clear.
segments.zh: 部分因为6月底低点后反弹强劲，盈利上修明显。

segments.en: But I'm actually would be cautious. I think the expectation is going building very high into the 3Q guidance as well.
segments.zh: 但我持谨慎态度，三季报指引的预期已非常高。
